name: Władysław Otto-Trąmpczyński

events.note: The regest of 1663 already calls her his wife.
Held Trąbczyn, Łazy, Osiny and the mill of Drzazgi; recorded his wife's dowry of 15,000 złp on half of them.
Dead by 1671, when his widow Anna Bojanowska is recorded in her second marriage; the decrees speak of him as "the late" Władysław.

notes: Married to Anna Bojanowska by 1663, when the regest already calls her his wife.
